ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible surface, with high-intensity pixels localized to distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity (black) region spanning the center-width. High-intensity (white) regions on lateral tips featuring dense vertical black stippling and flecking. One prominent isolated dark circular spot located in the white field of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serration along both lobes. A notable macroscopic notch is present on the trailing edge of the left lobe roughly midway to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward sweep on the distal edges of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular markings at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white fields on both lobes, primarily oriented vertically.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation/loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine high-intensity white stippling pattern across the central low-intensity region just above the waterline.
